## PART 3: UNDERWRITING DECISION MATRIX  
**Use This Matrix to Make Lending Decisions:**  
| Credit Score | Income DTI | LTV | Decision | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 90+ | <35% | <80% | **APPROVE** | Strong candidate |
| 90+ | 35–45% | <85% | **APPROVE** | Good candidate |
| 80–89 | <40% | <90% | **APPROVE** | Standard |
| 80–89 | 40–45% | <80% | **APPROVE** | Monitor |
| 70–79 | <35% | <75% | **CONDITIONAL** | Requires depth review |
| 70–79 | 35–45% | >75% | **CONDITIONAL** | Risk review needed |
| 60–69 | Any | Any | **DECLINE** | High default risk |
| <60 | Any | Any | **DECLINE** | Very high risk |

raw_entities.name: Credit Score Risk
raw_entities.description: Credit score assessment used as a primary underwriting criterion in the lending decision matrix. Scores range from <60 (very high risk, automatic decline) to 90+ (strong candidate for approval). Score thresholds directly determine approval, conditional, or decline outcomes.
context: Credit Score | Income DTI | LTV | Decision

raw_entities.name: Debt-to-Income Ratio Risk
raw_entities.description: Applicant income-to-debt ratio used as a secondary underwriting criterion. DTI thresholds range from <35% (favorable) to >45% (elevated risk). Combined with credit score and LTV, DTI determines lending decision outcome.

raw_entities.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio Risk
raw_entities.description: Loan-to-value ratio threshold used in the underwriting decision matrix. LTV ranges from <75% (lower risk) to >90% (higher risk). LTV combined with credit score and DTI determines approval, conditional, or decline decisions.

raw_entities.name: Default Risk
raw_entities.description: Default risk assessment applied to applicants with credit scores 60–69 (high default risk) or <60 (very high risk), resulting in automatic decline regardless of DTI or LTV. This is the primary risk trigger for lending rejection.

raw_entities.name: Credit Score Threshold
raw_entities.description: Credit score appetite thresholds embedded in the underwriting decision matrix. Scores of 90+ represent strong candidates; 80–89 standard; 70–79 conditional; 60–69 high risk; <60 very high risk with automatic decline.
context: Credit Score | Income DTI | LTV | Decision

raw_entities.name: Debt-to-Income Ratio Threshold
raw_entities.description: DTI appetite thresholds in the underwriting matrix. Favorable DTI is <35%; acceptable is 35–45%; DTI >45% combined with lower credit scores triggers conditional or decline decisions.

raw_entities.name: Loan-to-Value Ratio Threshold
raw_entities.description: LTV appetite thresholds in the underwriting matrix. LTV <80% is favorable; <85% acceptable; <90% standard; >75% combined with lower credit scores triggers conditional review or decline.

raw_entities.name: Underwriting Decision Matrix Approval Framework
raw_entities.description: Formal underwriting decision framework establishing three outcomes (APPROVE, CONDITIONAL, DECLINE) based on credit score, DTI, and LTV combinations. The matrix defines automatic approval for strong candidates (90+ credit score, <35% DTI, <80% LTV) and automatic decline for very high-risk applicants (<60 credit score).
context: Use This Matrix to Make Lending Decisions
